text.p: These are the leading stories in Zimbabwe's state-owned Herald newspaper on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Large tracts of Zimbabwean farming land which had been cleared of tsetse flies could be re-invaded by the flies from neighbouring Mozambique where there are no effective control programmes.

- Zimbabwe's information, posts and telecommunications minister Joyce Mujuru said on Monday there was need to attract investment into the telecommunications sector by making legal and policy reforms to improve communications and facilitate the development of countries' economies.

- Zimbabwe's civil servants have agreed on a November 8 deadline set by the government for it and worker's representatives to come up with concrete measures to resolve disputes involving salaries and conditions of service.
